verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API tokens for agents. The nearby items cover other things: team-level access and secrets management, connecting AI assistants to an account, and AI Gateway key handling. None of these shows credentials that can be limited in scope for an agent, so they earn no credit for this story.
